name: Family Reunification (Third-Country National)

requirements.blocker_text: Available to the spouse or registered partner (treated equivalent to marriage), minor children, and adult disabled children of a third-country national legally residing in Belgium on an A, B, C, D, F, F+, H, K, L, M, or M+ card.

Sponsor must show stable, regular and sufficient means of subsistence for themselves and joining family members, without becoming a burden on public authorities. Exempt for unlimited-stay-permit sponsors whose applicant is their own unmarried child arriving before age 18 as the sole joining member.

Sponsor must provide adequate housing meeting Belgian Civil Code standards for principal residences. Exempt for H-card (EU Blue Card) holders and long-term residents from another EU state if the family unit already existed there.

A 12-month waiting period on the sponsor's B, C, D, F, F+, K, or L card applies before family reunification can be sought, UNLESS the marriage/partnership pre-existed the sponsor's arrival in Belgium, the partners share a child, or the sponsor holds international protection status.
requirements.fix_path: Wait 12 months from the sponsor's card grant, or show one of the stated exceptions applies.

evidence_required.document: Marriage/partnership certificate or proof of parentage

outcome.duration_length: typically matches the sponsor's permit type/duration

sources.title: IBZ -- Family Reunification (Third-Country Nationals): eligible family members, sponsor income/housing standards and exemptions, 12-month waiting-period rule and its exceptions

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Belgium). The 12-month waiting period (with its pre-existing-relationship, shared-child, and international-protection exceptions) is a genuinely distinctive anti-marriage-of-convenience mechanic sourced directly from the government portal, more precisely specified than most family reunification builds in this dataset.
